confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough estimates from a few aggregator and guide sources; the restaurant guide was last updated in 2024, and the beer and cappuccino figures come from mixed-quality sites that are not specific to Hampi. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of small Karnataka tourist towns, not from inspected listings. Cocktail and wine were not directly sourced: cocktail is a judgment relative to the beer anchor, and wine_glass is estimated at roughly twice the draft beer anchor because Hampi has limited wine supply. The FX observation could not be verified: the search did not return an rba.gov.au F11 page, and the third-party figures found were not official RBA data, so fx fields are null. USD conversion uses an approximate INR rate of about 90 per USD, which is not a sourced figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Small tourist towns in Karnataka and South India with guesthouse-led accommodation and modest restaurant prices, adjusted using Indian restaurant and beer price ranges from the search results.
